name: sbc-signer-extension
description: A Nostr extension. Log into any Nostr client, and comment on any webpage from your browser.

scripts.build:chrome: npm i --silent && vite build -l error && echo 'Chrome extension built to dist/chrome/'
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && mkdir -p dist/artifacts && rm -f "dist/artifacts/sbc-signer-extension-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip" && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr "../artifacts/sbc-signer-extension-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip" . && echo "Chrome package written to dist/artifacts/sbc-signer-extension-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip"
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename "sbc-signer-extension-firefox-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest
scripts.test: npm i --silent && tsc --noEmit && eslint --cache && vitest run --reporter=dot --silent && npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:firefox && echo 'All tests passed!'
